safety_review.findings: A fresh non-author reviewer, claude-opus-5-5, read every weigh line in all 13 banks on 2026-11-25 after the reply format B rewrite (weigh as a คิดต่อ / Next thought question), in all 3 alternatives, Thai and English, against every question variant and every path into each bank. Strength and safety are byte-identical to the bank reviewed on 2026-11-14, as are keys and order (checked by script against HEAD). Blanked: step2.R.full_r, a best option whose old weigh lines were generic (watch vitals while results come, operator-dependent ultrasound, read results together); accepted. Must-fixes applied: step4.B.taper en[1] "Which oral pain relief is safe for the liver of a man who drinks daily?" → "In a man who drinks daily, which oral pain relief will you choose, and at what dose?" (the old wording invited swapping paracetamol for an NSAID as the liver-safe drug; th[1] reworded to match); step4.W.dzp en[2] "Withdrawal can peak over the next day or two: which sign would worry you most?" → "Withdrawal can worsen over the next day or two: which sign would worry you most?" (matches the Thai หนักขึ้น). Other judgments: the moderate-fluids, no-PPI, no-NG, no-early-CT, early-feeding, withdrawal-scoring and brief-alcohol-intervention questions are sound against ACG 2024 and ASAM 2020; step1.b "Does the drinking history settle the cause, or only make it likely?" is a fair question about the chosen cause and names no step 2 option; thiamine, CIWA-Ar and alcohol-advice questions at step 3 sit inside the chosen option's own label and do not give away step 4 or 5.
